After multiplying the difference by e^(2lambda_1t), pair each even k with k+1; the ratio (lambda_{k+1}-lambda_1)/(lambda_k-lambda_1)<=8/3 and epsilon<=1/16 enforce every paired contribution strictly decreasing. Opposite endpoint signs prove exactly one quadratic crossing. k=2 vs k=1 balancing gives T_N and an additive -1/(6pi²omega) with controlled higher-mode tails.
